title: Chlamydia plasmid-encoded protein Pgp2 is a replication initiator with a unique beta-hairpin necessary for iteron-binding and plasmid replication.
authors: Wan, Danny; Pan, Matthew; Zhong, Guangming; Fan, Huizhou
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold预测衣原体质粒复制起始蛋白Pgp2结构并鉴定其β-hairpin基序对iteron-DNA结合的关键作用，属蛋白质-DNA互作的结构建模研究，但对象为质粒复制起始蛋白而非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以结构预测为主，可迁移借鉴。
abstract: The virulence plasmid of the obligate intracellular bacterium Chlamydia encodes eight proteins. Among these, Pgp3 is crucial for pathogenicity, and Pgp4 functions as a transcriptional regulator of both plasmid and chromosomal genes. The remaining proteins, Pgp1, Pgp5, Pgp6, Pgp7, and Pgp8, are predicted to play various roles in plasmid replication or maintenance based on their amino acid sequences. However, the function of Pgp2 remains unknown, even though it is required for transformation. In this study, we utilized AlphaFold to predict the 3-dimensional (3-D) structure of C. trachomatis Pgp2. Despite a lack of apparent sequence homology, the AlphaFold structure exhibited high similarity to experimentally determined structures of several plasmid replication initiators. Notably, Pgp2 features a unique beta-hairpin motif near the DNA-binding domain, absent in other plasmid replication initiators with overall 3-D structures similar to Pgp2. This beta-hairpin motif was also present in AlphaFold models of Pgp2s across all 13 Chlamydia species. To assess its significance, we engineered a plasmid lacking the 11 amino acids constituting the beta-hairpin motif in C. trachomatis Pgp2. Although this deletion did not alter the overall structure of Pgp2, the mutated plasmid failed to transform plasmid-free C. trachomatis. These findings reveal that Pgp2 is a plasmid replication initiator, with the beta-hairpin motif playing a critical role in binding to its cognate iteron sequences in the replication origin of the chlamydial plasmid.
abstract_zh: 专性胞内菌衣原体的毒力质粒编码八种蛋白质。其中，Pgp3对致病性至关重要，Pgp4作为质粒和染色体基因的转录调节因子发挥作用。其余蛋白质Pgp1、Pgp5、Pgp6、Pgp7和Pgp8，根据其氨基酸序列预测在质粒复制或维持中扮演多种角色。然而，Pgp2的功能仍未知，尽管它是转化所必需的。在本研究中，我们利用AlphaFold预测了沙眼衣原体Pgp2的三维（3-D）结构。尽管缺乏明显的序列同源性，AlphaFold结构显示出与几种质粒复制起始因子实验测定结构的高度相似性。值得注意的是，Pgp2在DNA结合域附近具有独特的β-发夹基序，这在其他整体3-D结构与Pgp2相似的质粒复制起始因子中不存在。该β-发夹基序也存在于所有13种衣原体物种的Pgp2 AlphaFold模型中。为评估其重要性，我们构建了一个缺失沙眼衣原体Pgp2中构成β-发夹基序的11个氨基酸的质粒。尽管此缺失未改变Pgp2的整体结构，但突变质粒未能转化无质粒的沙眼衣原体。这些发现揭示Pgp2是质粒复制起始因子，其中β-发夹基序在结合衣原体质粒复制起点中的同源iteron序列方面起关键作用。
